G1_grounding.detail: 8 positive PET-hydrolase/cutinase structures (5XJH,6EQE,9LMU,4EB0,1CUS,5ZOA,8ETX,8ETY) + 3 negatives (3WA6 tannase, 1USW FaeA, 1TCA lipase B), all live-verified at RCSB; ACT_SITE triads from live UniProt for 4 positives; met pre-lock.

G2_structures.detail: ESMFold structures for 20/20 candidates (>=18 required); per-residue pLDDT recorded (results/plddt_summary.json); no failures.

G3_foldseek.detail: 20/20 candidates pass leg C (best hit positive-panel, E<=1e-3, alntmscore>=0.5; actual TM range 0.843-0.973, E<=6.8e-13). Calibration: all 8 positive-panel queries have positive-panel non-self best hits. LIMITATION PRESERVED: all 3 negative controls also cross-hit positives at fold level (3WA6->5XJH E=2.8e-5 TM=0.576; 1TCA_A->9LMU E=7.0e-8 TM=0.537; 1USW_A->9LMU E=5.1e-4 TM=0.434) - fold-level search cannot distinguish alpha/beta-hydrolase families; discrimination is carried by register legs A/B.

G4_model.detail: Calibration: all 4 ACT_SITE-grounded positives pass legs A and B (panel PDB geometry in bounds; pLDDT clause applies to predicted structures only - documented interpretation for experimental structures); negatives fail >=1 leg A (B3Y018 no triad; O42807 D->H=53 outside [10,36]). Candidates: 19/20 pass A^B^C (>=12 required). Single failure MGYP001374132912 preserved: leg A fail (H237 register -> A, D_H=71) + leg B fail (S-H 18.78 A, D-H 13.75 A, triad pLDDT 58.7); its fold is intact (leg C pass, TM 0.928 to 5XJH) but the catalytic register/geometry is disrupted - exactly the failure mode the register-aware model was built to catch. NOTE: R2's triad check scored this candidate triad_intact=True; R3's register-aware scoring overrides on structure-grade evidence.

unit_documentation: ESMFold API returns pLDDT in B-factor column on 0-1 scale; multiplied by 100 for the locked '>=50' threshold which is on the conventional 0-100 pLDDT scale. Unit normalization only; gate text unmodified.
